text:
juno-sales: Polaris Systems POC is blocked by their CISO. They need a short-lived VPC peering + a 30min high-throughput demo for execs tomorrow 15:30 UTC. Also asking for a firm demo spend cap and SSO access for their security reviewer. Need quick signoff. :exclamation:

kai-eng: We can do peering + KV warmup. Ask: exact CIDR and how much throughput they need for the 30min window?

juno-sales: CIDR 203.0.113.0/28. Polaris asked for 50Mbps for 30min. They'll accept up to $2k. Exec wants confirmation today.

marco-ops: We can create a TTL peering (4h) and an egress_override for 50Mbps. Need KMS alias and list of reviewer /32s for SSO mapping. Draft ACL below and runbook will be created.

marco-ops: ```
peering_id: polaris-demo-01
from_tenant: redwood-demo-tenant
to_cidr: 203.0.113.0/28
allowed_ports: [443]
duration_hours: 4
egress_limit_mbps: 50
acl: ["203.0.113.12/32","203.0.113.13/32"]
logging_kms_alias: "alias/polaris-demo-logs"
```

sana-security: Conditions: TLS-only, logs to customer KMS alias, retention 60d, SSO read-only for their reviewer. I can fast-track if final ACL + runbook link posted.

kai-eng: Also request model routing fallback to hosted endpoint and KV cache pre-warm 10min prior. Marco, can you add health-checks and a fallback route?

marco-ops: Yes. Will enable health-check every 10s and add fallback to hosted-primary. Creating runbook RB-12654 and staging config now. ops-bot will post status.

ops-bot: [change-request] polaris-demo-01 requested by marco-ops. Runbook RB-12654 created. staged -> pending validation.

kai-eng: Smoke test from restricted host: TLS handshake ok, synthetic requests succeed, median latency 118ms with warm cache. KV warmup looks good.

sana-security: Reviewing staged ACL and runbook. KMS alias present and exact /32s provided. Signing off with condition that logs use their KMS alias and SSO access granted. :white_check_mark:

tess-csm: I approve the $2k capped demo charge. I'll email procurement and confirm PO note.

marco-ops: Deploying live peering now. ops-bot: deploy -> live in eu-west-1. Scheduling teardown 17:15 UTC (45min after window).

ops-bot: [deploy] polaris-demo-01 live. Runbook RB-12654 monitoring.

kai-eng: Verified demo route, fallback in place. Latency stable ~120ms. Ready for execs.

juno-sales: Thanks team. Tess sending PO and I'll update Polaris. Marco please revert peering after teardown and confirm here.

marco-ops: Teardown complete at 17:18 UTC. Peering removed, egress caps reverted, logs archived to alias/polaris-demo-logs. Closing thread.

tess-csm: Confirmed PO sent and procurement looped in. Good job everyone :clap:
